q1.explanationZh: culture 加 -al 构成形容词 cultural“文化（上）的”。

q2.explanationZh: culture 名词“文化，文明”，形容词是 cultural。

q4.explanationZh: cupboard = cup + board，注意 p 不发音，读 /ˈkʌbəd/。

q5.explanationZh: cure 名词“治疗；药”，动词“治愈”，cure sb. of sth.“治好某人的病”。

q6.explanationZh: curious 形容词“好奇的”，be curious about sth.“对……好奇”，名词 curiosity。

q7.explanationZh: currency“货币”，与 current 同源，表示“流通的东西”。

q8.explanationZh: current 形容词“现时的”，名词“（空气、水、电等）流”；副词 currently“目前”。

q9.explanationZh: curriculum“课程”，复数有两种：curricula（拉丁式）或 curriculums。

q10.explanationZh: curtain“窗帘；幕”，draw the curtains“拉上窗帘”。

q11.explanationZh: curve 名词“曲线”，动词“（使）弯曲”。

q12.explanationZh: cushion“垫子；气垫”，注意 -ion 前是 sh：cu-sh-ion。

q13.explanationZh: custom“习俗”，指社会长期形成的风俗；个人习惯用 habit。

q14.explanationZh: customer“顾客”，由 custom（惯常光顾）加 -er 构成。

q15.explanationZh: cut 动词“切；削减”，名词“切口；削减”，过去式、过去分词仍是 cut。

q16.explanationZh: cute 形容词“可爱的”，多用于美式英语。

q17.explanationZh: cycle 名词“周期；循环；自行车”，动词“循环；骑自行车”。

q18.explanationZh: cycle 去 e 加 -ist 构成 cyclist“骑自行车的人”。

q19.explanationZh: day 变 y 为 i 加 -ly 构成 daily“每日的”，也可作名词“日报”，如 China Daily。

q20.explanationZh: dairy“乳品店；乳品的”，dairy product“乳制品”；注意与 daily 区分：dairy 是 -ir-。

q21.explanationZh: dam“水坝”，只有三个字母，不要和 damn 混淆。

q22.explanationZh: damage 动词、名词同形，“损坏”，cause damage to“对……造成损坏”。

q23.explanationZh: damp 名词“潮湿”，动词“使潮湿”，形容词“潮湿的”。

q24.explanationZh: dance 名词“舞蹈”，动词“跳舞”。

q25.explanationZh: danger 名词“危险”，in danger“处于危险中”。

q26.explanationZh: danger 加 -ous 构成形容词 dangerous“危险的”。

q27.explanationZh: dare“敢”，可作情态动词（dare not do）也可作实义动词（don’t dare to do）。

q28.explanationZh: dark 形容词“黑暗的”，名词“黑暗”，名词 darkness。

q29.explanationZh: darling“心爱的人；亲爱的”，常用作亲昵的称呼。

q30.explanationZh: dash 名词“猛冲；破折号”，动词“猛冲”。

q31.explanationZh: database = data（数据）+ base（基地），“数据库”。

q32.explanationZh: datum“数据”的复数是 data，以 -um 结尾的拉丁词复数变 -a。

q33.explanationZh: date 名词“日期；约会”，动词“注明日期；追溯”，date back to“追溯到”。

q34.explanationZh: be curious about sth.“对……感到好奇”。

q35.explanationZh: cure sb. of sth.“治好某人的……；使某人改掉……”。

q36.explanationZh: be curious to do sth.“很想做某事”，curious 后接不定式。

q37.explanationZh: cut down on“削减（开支、用量等）”，手册词组写作 cut down。

q43.explanationZh: damp down“减弱（火势）；给……泼冷水”。

q44.explanationZh: damp off“（幼苗）因水分过多而溺死”。

q45.explanationZh: in danger“处于危险中”，反义是 out of danger。

q47.explanationZh: make a dash for/at“向……急进；冲向”，dash 作名词“猛冲”。

q48.explanationZh: date back to“追溯到”，相当于 date from。

q49.explanationZh: “西方人有过圣诞节的习俗”，社会形成的习俗用 custom，个人习惯用 habit。

q51.explanationZh: a current of air“一股气流”，current 作名词“（空气、水等）流”。

q52.explanationZh: touched wheels with another rider 说明是骑车的人，A 后用单数 cyclist。

q53.explanationZh: cut down on“削减”，to 后用动词原形 cut。

q54.explanationZh: 有搁板和门、放碗碟或衣物的是 cupboard“橱柜”。

q55.explanationZh: draw the curtains“拉上窗帘”，窗帘通常成对，用复数 curtains。

q56.explanationZh: all the 后接可数名词复数，customers“顾客”。

q57.explanationZh: “hip-hop”是一种流行舞蹈，dance 作名词“舞蹈”。

q58.explanationZh: the date of the meeting“开会的日期”。

q59.sampleAnswer: There is no certain cure for his disease.
references: There is no certain cure for his disease.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: cure 作名词“药物；疗法”，a cure for ...“治疗……的药”。

q60.sampleAnswer: I’m most curious about how they achieved success.
references: I’m most curious about how they achieved success.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “最想知道”= be most curious about，about 后接 how 引导的宾语从句。

q61.sampleAnswer: It was unusual for someone at such an old age to dance Swan Lake on stage.
references: It was unusual for someone at such an old age to dance Swan Lake on stage.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: It was unusual for sb. to do sth. 句型，dance 作及物动词“跳（某种舞）”。

q62.sampleAnswer: The village was cut off from the outside world for a month because of the heavy snow.
references: The village was cut off from the outside world for a month because of the heavy snow.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “与外界隔绝”用被动 be cut off from the outside world。

q63.sampleAnswer: In face of danger, the more desperate you are, the less chance there is that you will survive.
references: In face of danger, the more desperate you are, the less chance there is that you will survive.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “面临危险”= in face of danger；“越……越……”用 the more ..., the less ...。

q64.sampleAnswer: In order to catch up with other students, he is trying to cure himself of bad habits in his study.
references: In order to catch up with other students, he is trying to cure himself of bad habits in his study.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: cure oneself of“改掉（坏习惯）”，主语是 he，所以用 himself。

q65.sampleAnswer: There are few people who would believe that these books date back to the 15th century.
references: There are few people who would believe that these books date back to the 15th century.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: date back to“追溯到”，不用被动语态；few 表示“很少有人”。

q66.sampleAnswer: As long as you persevere in your current effort, it is only a matter of time before you get where you want to be.
references: As long as you persevere in your current effort, it is only a matter of time before you get where you want to be.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: current 形容词“现在的”；“只是时间问题”= it is only a matter of time before ...。

q67.sampleAnswer: In recent years, many universities have established financial laboratories, where students collect and analyse data in order to deepen their understanding of the significance behind the data.
references: In recent years, many universities have established financial laboratories, where students collect and analyse data in order to deepen their understanding of the significance behind the data.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: data 是 datum 的复数“数据”；where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 laboratories。

q68.sampleAnswer: If we regard English learning as a means of understanding a culture but not an examination course, then we may understand the learning fun in it.
references: If we regard English learning as a means of understanding a culture but not an examination course, then we may understand the learning fun in it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: regard ... as ...“把……看作……”；a means of understanding a culture“了解一种文化的方式”。
